value.rationale: The cut is canonical for arbitrary independent row and column two-colorings. The closed two-by-two arithmetic obstruction classifies all four-positive-block-size entanglement spectra across every prime local dimension, including three different rank regimes and examples where changing the prime changes entanglement. Its O(m+n) entropy contrasts sharply with mn qudits and the dense graph interaction cut, motivating exact resource estimates and illustrating nontrivial correlation redundancy. It is not an arbitrary finite invariant or unmotivated parameter slice.
